items.title: Contact form 'From' email updated
items.description: After launch, the Contact Form 7 'From' field is set to an address on the live domain to avoid validation errors.

items.title: Anti-spam reCAPTCHA installed
items.description: reCAPTCHA v3 is installed and active on all contact forms to prevent spam.

items.title: Mobile-friendly test
items.description: The site passes Google's Mobile-Friendly Test.

items.title: Find & replace old URLs
items.description: All instances of the old URL have been replaced with the new URL across the site.

items.title: Search & replace old URLs
items.description: All old URL instances have been searched and replaced with the new ones across the site.

items.title: Site is indexed
items.description: The live site is being indexed by search engines.

items.title: Featured images on main pages
items.description: Main pages have Featured Images set to improve social sharing thumbnails.

items.title: Site is indexable
items.description: Search engine visibility is enabled in WordPress reading settings.

items.title: Website speed
items.description: Site speed has been tested on the live site.

items.title: Image optimization
items.description: Images are properly sized and compressed. https://wordpress.org/plugins/wp-optimize/

items.title: SSL
items.description: SSL is installed correctly and the site is served over HTTPS without mixed content.

items.title: Call tracking tool?
items.description: Confirm whether this client will have call tracking managed by {{callTrackingProvider}}.

items.title: Call tracking code installed
items.description: We have access to the {{callTrackingTool}} account and the call-tracking code is installed on the site.

items.title: Call tracking onboarding doc
items.description: The correct call-tracking onboarding document has been copied and linked in the Notes column.

items.title: Access to analytics account
items.description: If the client has a GA account, admin access is shared with {{teamEmail}}; otherwise a new property is created.

items.title: Set up Google Tag Manager
items.description: If the client has a GTM account, admin access is shared with {{teamEmail}}; otherwise a new account is created.

items.title: Set up GA4 via GTM
items.description: Google Analytics 4 is installed through Google Tag Manager and the GTM code is on the site.

items.title: Set up Search Console
items.description: The site is added and verified in Google Search Console.

items.title: XML sitemap in Search Console
items.description: An XML sitemap is submitted to GSC, with category, tag, author, and date sitemaps removed.

items.title: Run a technical SEO audit
items.description: A technical SEO audit has been run and the results added to the Technical Audit tab.

items.title: Run an on-page SEO audit
items.description: An on-page SEO audit has been run and the results added to the Technical Audit tab.

items.title: No links to staging
items.description: No links pointing to the staging site remain on the live site.

items.title: Add default schema markup
items.description: Basic JSON-LD has been added using the appropriate markup schema template.

items.title: Remove no-index tag
items.description: The noindex tag is removed so the site can be crawled.

items.title: Review robots.txt
items.description: The robots.txt file is correctly configured (by Yoast).

items.title: Core Web Vitals — Live
items.description: Re-run LCP, INP, and CLS on the live domain after launch. Live performance often differs from staging due to CDN and caching differences. SUCCESS: LCP < 2.5s, INP < 200ms, CLS < 0.1 on live. FAIL: Any metric fails — report scores and top improvement suggestions.

items.title: Cookie Consent — Live Test
items.description: On the live site in a fresh incognito window, open DevTools > Application > Cookies and confirm no GA4, GTM, or pixel cookies are stored before the user accepts the banner. SUCCESS: No non-essential cookies before consent. FAIL: Any tracking cookies fire before user accepts — fix immediately.

items.title: Schema Drift Check
items.description: After launch, verify JSON-LD schema still reflects accurate live content: phone, address, hours, services. CMS updates and plugin changes can silently break schema. SUCCESS: All schema fields match live page content. FAIL: Schema contains outdated or mismatched data — flag specific fields.

items.title: AI Search Visibility Check
items.description: Search business name and primary service in Google AI Mode, Perplexity, and ChatGPT. Check Google Search Console for rich result impressions. SUCCESS: Site appears in AI citations or rich results in GSC. FAIL: No citations or rich results — review schema and content authority.

items.title: Regenerate CSS after updates
items.description: After any plugin or theme update on live site, run Elementor Tools Regenerate CSS and Data immediately.

items.title: No JS errors in console
items.description: Open DevTools console on homepage and key landing pages - no Elementor related JS errors.

items.title: Core Web Vitals post launch
items.description: Re run PageSpeed Insights on the live URL. LCP is often an Elementor hero image and needs specific attention.

items.title: Forms working on live site
items.description: Test that all forms work on the live site — submit a test entry and confirm email delivery, connections, and success messages.

items.title: Real device breakpoint test
items.description: Verify layout on a real iPhone and Android device. Browser resize does not replicate real device rendering.

items.title: Pro license on live domain
items.description: Confirm Elementor Pro license is activated for the live domain and not just staging.

items.title: DOM count not increased
items.description: Verify DOM node count has not grown after content editors added new sections or widgets.

items.title: CSS file accessible post deploy
items.description: After deployment, verify yootheme CSS loads without 403 forbidden. Permissions can reset on deploy.

items.title: No JS errors post launch
items.description: Check browser console for UIkit or plugin related JS errors on homepage and key pages after launch.

items.title: Customizer changes save
items.description: Verify the theme customizer saves correctly and changes appear on the frontend. Not serving stale cached CSS.

items.title: File permissions persist
items.description: Some hosts reset folder permissions on deployment. Re verify yootheme directory after each deploy.

items.title: Staging to prod parity check
items.description: Visual sweep of all pages to confirm staging to production parity. No missing images, broken layouts, or missing elements.

items.title: UIkit compat after WP update
items.description: After WordPress core updates, run through all UIkit interactive components to confirm they still function.

items.title: No missing utility classes
items.description: Browse all pages and check for unstyled elements. Aggressive CSS purge is a common post launch find.

items.title: No CDN fallback in production
items.description: Verify no Tailwind CDN script tag in production HTML. Only the compiled CSS file should be loaded.

items.title: Build pipeline documented
items.description: If no CI or CD: confirm build steps are documented so any developer can rebuild CSS after template changes.

items.title: WP core update compatibility
items.description: After every WordPress update, verify core CSS changes do not conflict with Tailwind styles.

items.title: ACF dynamic content styled
items.description: Verify all ACF custom fields display with correct Tailwind styling. No classes purged from dynamic output.

items.title: Forms and interactive elements
items.description: Test all JS dependent interactive elements dropdowns, modals, sliders function with the compiled custom CSS.
